_comment: Example operator profile. Copy to operator.profile.json and edit, OR run `python scripts/setup_wizard.py` to generate it interactively. The live operator.profile.json is gitignored.
preferred_name: What the agent should call you
personal_brand: Your personal brand (DJ name, creator handle, etc.) or blank
north_star: Your one metric + deadline (e.g., $10K MRR by 2027-Q1)
industry: agency | saas | ecommerce | services | content-creator | consulting | finance | other
daily_work: What you actually do day-to-day, in one sentence.
off_limits: Hard rules the agent must never violate (e.g., no autonomous sends, no .env edits, no pushes to main).
voice: Adjectives + samples + anti-patterns describing how you sound.
